an3.62:1.1: tīṇimāni bhikkhave, amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:1.3: hoti so bhikkhave samayo, yaṃ mahāaggiḍāho uṭṭhāti.
an3.62:1.4: mahāaggiḍāhe kho pana bhikkhave, uṭṭhite tena gāmāpi ḍayhanti, nigamāpi ḍayhanti, nagarāpi ḍayhanti.
an3.62:1.5: gāmesupi ḍayhamānesu nigamesupi ḍayhamānesu nagaresupi ḍayhamānesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati.
an3.62:1.6: idaṃ bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ mahāmegho uṭṭhāti.
an3.62:2.2: mahāmeghe kho pana bhikkhave, uṭṭhite mahāudakavāhako sañjāyati.
an3.62:2.3: mahāudakavāhake kho pana bhikkhave, sañjāte tena gāmāpi vuyhanti, nigamāpi vuyhanti, nagarāpi vuyhanti.
an3.62:2.4: gāmesupi vuyhamānesu nigamesupi vuyhamānesu nagaresupi vuyhamānesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati.
an3.62:2.5: idaṃ bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, hoti so samayo, yaṃ bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅaṃkopo, cakkasamāruḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti.
an3.62:3.2: bhaye kho pana bhikkhave, sati aṭavisaṃkope cakkasamāruḷhesu jānapadesu pariyāyantesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati.
an3.62:3.3: idaṃ bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:3.4: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:4.1: tāni kho panimāni bhikkhave, tīṇi samātāputtikāniyeva bhayāni amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:4.3: hoti so bhikkhave, samayo, yaṃ mahāaggiḍāho uṭṭhāti.
an3.62:4.4: mahāaggiḍāhe kho pana bhikkhave, uṭṭhite tena gāmāpi …pe… nagarāpi ḍayhanti.
an3.62:4.5: gāmesupi ḍayhamānesu nigamesupi ḍayhamānesu nagaresupi ḍayhamānesu hoti so samayo, yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati.
an3.62:4.6: idaṃ bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ samātāputtikaṃ yeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, hoti so samayo, yaṃ mahāmegho uṭṭhāti.
an3.62:5.2: mahāmeghe kho pana bhikkhave, uṭṭhite mahāudakavāhako sañjāyati.
an3.62:5.3: mahāudakavāhake kho pana bhikkhave, sañjāte tena gāmāpi vuyhanti, nigamāpi vuyhanti, nagarāpi vuyhanti.
an3.62:5.4: gāmesupi vuyhamānesu nigamesupi vuyhamānesu nagaresupi vuyhamānesu hoti so samayo, yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati.
an3.62:5.5: idaṃ bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ samātāputtikaṃ yeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, hoti so samayo, yaṃ bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamāruḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti.
an3.62:6.2: bhaye kho pana bhikkhave, sati aṭavisaṅkope cakkasamārūḷhesu jānapadesu pariyāyantesu hoti so samayo, yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati, puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati.
an3.62:6.3: idaṃ bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ samātāputtikaṃ yeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:6.4: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi samātāputtikāni yeva bhayāni amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:7.4: na bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ jīramānaṃ evaṃ labhati :
an3.62:7.5: ahaṃ jīrāmi, mā me putto jīrīti.
an3.62:7.6: putto vā pana mātaraṃ jīramānaṃ na evaṃ labhati,
an3.62:7.7: ahaṃ jīrāmi mā me mātā jīrīti.
an3.62:8.1: na bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ vyādhiyamānaṃ evaṃ labhati :
an3.62:8.2: ahaṃ vyādhiyāmi, mā me putto vyādhiyīti,
an3.62:8.3: putto vā pana mātaraṃ vyādhiyamānaṃ na evaṃ labhati :
an3.62:8.4: ahaṃ vyādhiyāmi, mā me mātā vyādhiyīti.
an3.62:9.1: na bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ mīyamānaṃ evaṃ labhati :
an3.62:9.2: ahaṃ mīyāmi, mā me putto mīyīti,
an3.62:9.3: putto vā pana mātaraṃ mīyamānaṃ na evaṃ labhati :
an3.62:9.4: ahaṃ mīyāmi, mā me mātā mīyīti.
an3.62:9.5: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi amātāputtikāni bhayānīti.
an3.62:10.1: atthi bhikkhave, maggo, atthi paṭipadā, imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ, imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahāṇāya samatikkamāya saṃvattati.
an3.62:10.2: katamo ca bhikkhave maggo : katamā ca paṭipadā : imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ, imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahāṇāya samatikkamāya saṃvattati :
an3.62:10.5: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave maggo, ayaṃ paṭipadā, imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahāṇāya samatikkamāya saṃvattatīti.
